html:
The World Events timetable. The daily events show in seven day columns on the right day and time for the reader's own time zone, and the game time events (the rifts and Jola/Meina/Glenn) get their own panel with their next times for the next 24 hours. Everything lives on two data pages, Module:WorldEventData for the events and Module:GameTimeData for the game clock (kept right by the sync bot), so a change is a single edit.

Usage 

{{WorldEventTimetable}}
  • layout (optional) picks the look. auto (default) shows seven day columns on wide screens and a day by day list on phones. week always shows the columns and agenda always shows the list.
  • header (optional) is yes by default. Write no to hide the game clock, the time zone and the note.
  • daily, trader and gametime (optional) are yes by default. Write no to leave out the daily events, the Freedich Gold Trader card or the game time panel.
  • The time zone conversion and the game time need the script of this table in MediaWiki:Common.js. Without it the table shows server time (New York) and the game time hours.
  • The pictures are the files Event_*.png listed in Module:WorldEventData.
  • Needs Module:WorldEventTimetable, Module:WorldEventData, Module:GameTimeData and Template:WorldEventTimetable/styles.css.
